name: Marching Cubes on GPU
definition: A technique to construct an isosurface mesh from a 4D Perlin noise volume using compute shaders, where the surface shader retrieves vertex data from a compute buffer and renders it with a physically based standard shader.
summary: Marching Cubes on GPU is a surface extraction technique that uses compute shaders to parallelize mesh generation from 3D scalar volumes, differing from other GPU variants by using structured buffers for data storage.
